examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{汗|あせ}をたくさんかく。
examples.english: I sweat a lot in summer.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}して{汗|あせ}だくになった。
examples.english: I got drenched in sweat from exercising.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}して{手|て}に{汗|あせ}を{握|にぎ}った。
examples.english: I was so nervous that my palms were sweating.

notes:
{汗|あせ} refers to sweat or perspiration.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {汗|あせ}をかく: to sweat
- {汗|あせ}を{拭|ふ}く: to wipe sweat
- {汗|あせ}が{出|で}る: to start sweating
- {汗|あせ}だく: drenched in sweat

IDIOMS:
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}: cold sweat (from fear or nervousness)
- {汗水|あせみず}{垂|た}らす: to work hard (lit. dripping with sweat)
- {脂汗|あぶらあせ}: greasy sweat (from pain or distress)

COMPOUNDS:
- {発汗|はっかん}: perspiration (medical term)
- {汗腺|かんせん}: sweat gland
- {手|て}に{汗|あせ}{握|にぎ}る: nail-biting, suspenseful
